sn4.4:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye.
sn4.4:2.1: mayhaṃ kho bhikkhave yonisomanasikārā yonisosammappadhānā anuttarā vimutti anuppattā anuttarā vimutti sacchikatā
sn4.4:2.2: tumhepi bhikkhave yonisomanasikārā yonisosammappadhānā anuttaraṃ vimuttiṃ anupāpuṇātha anuttaraṃ vimuttiṃ sacchikarothāti.
sn4.4:2.3: atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
